Modern Marisa's Hitback Is Chosen by What Survives a Block, Not Only by What Hits

Ryusei's idea is simple but deep: at the moment the turn changes, choose a move by asking what remains even if it is blocked. This article translates that idea into current Year 4 Modern Marisa, separating guaranteed punishes from turn-reclaim decisions and evaluating 5M, 2M, 4H, charged 4H, 5H, Phalanx, and H Quadriga through startup, block state, cancel routes, spacing, and Drive Gauge.
